task_description: Return the recipes that contain a given ingredient.
Look up a shipment by tracking number.
Mark an invoice as paid by its invoice number (a text code such as INV-2041).
Search apartments by an optional city and an optional maximum rent.
Read a nickname saved at sign-up and list the forum posts signed with it.
Fetch the latest readings for a numeric sensor id.
Change the priority of a task, given its numeric id and the new priority.
Remove a member from a team by member id.
Look up a user's profile by username.
List the newest posts in a category, sorted by a column the caller chooses.
